questions: Should the PDF be computed using the raw values or their absolute values, as the prompt mentions both options but the clarification only addresses tuple structure?
What should happen if the standard deviation is zero (e.g., all values identical)? The PDF plot may be degenerate or cause errors.
Is the PDF always a normal distribution, or should it match the distribution of the data (e.g., kernel density estimate)?
Should the histogram and PDF use the raw numeric values as extracted, or should they be transformed (e.g., absolute values) based on some condition?
What if the tuple has more than two elements? Should only the second element be extracted, or all numeric elements after the first?
Should the function handle non-numeric second elements (e.g., strings) by skipping, converting, or raising an error?
Is the Axes object expected to have specific labels (x-axis, y-axis) or only the title and legend as shown?
Should the PDF be computed over the entire data range or limited to the histogram's x-axis limits as determined by 'auto' bins?
